xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2633: bug(dashboard): pending-question payload wiped when an idle-alive asking agent flaps to 'stopped' — needs-you entry vanishes while the question is still live

plan.title: bug(dashboard): pending-question payload wiped when an idle-alive asking agent flaps to 'stopped' — needs-you entry vanishes while the question is still live
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The agent.status_changed fold (packages/contracts/src/event-reducers.ts:494-503, PAN-1520) deletes all pending-input fields (pendingAskUserQuestion, pendingInputKinds, pendingProposedPlan, …) for ANY non-running/starting status, ignoring the hasLiveTmuxSession boolean the payload already carries. An idle-alive agent — registry status 'stopped' while its tmux pane is alive and showing a live AskUserQuestion — loses its needs-you entry and modal on a status flap. Nothing restores the payload: the enrichment poller keeps scanning tmux-alive agents but dedups against its private lastEnrichment cache (agent-enrichment-service.ts:207), which cannot see the read-model wipe, so no agent.enrichment_changed is re-emitted. Operator recovery required a page refresh (incident: agent-pan-2568-slot-3, 2026-07-13).
narratives.Proposal: Three independently mergeable slices. (1) Gate the reducer wipe on liveness: delete pending-input fields on a stop-shaped status_changed only when event.payload.hasLiveTmuxSession !== true (absent ⇒ still wipe, preserving PAN-1520 fail-safe). (2) Thread accurate hasLiveTmuxSession through every status_changed emitter that can emit non-running status (lifecycle-stop pause/unpause/untroubled via async sessionExists; main.ts/deacon-main.ts stopped-notifiers pass explicit false; deacon-auto-resume already explicit) with a git-grep audit. (3) Enrichment poller convergence: a pure helper shouldForceReemitPendingInput bypasses the dedup for tmux-alive agents whose registry status is non-running while enrichment carries a pending payload, so the read model converges within one 10s poll after any wipe — WITHOUT clearing lastEnrichment, keeping the PAN-1834 awaiting-input activity/TTS rising edge single-shot. Plus docs (PENDING-INPUT.md invariant). Full PRD with verified line references: drafts/pan-2633.md on overdeck-state.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No clickable deep-links for plain activity-log lines (PAN-1844)
- No redesign of the enrichment dedup to diff against the read model instead of its private cache
- No wiring or deleting the currently-uncalled projectPendingInput (read-model.ts:260)
- No change to the agent.stopped fold (full row removal on true stop stays)
- No change to deacon auto-resume/reconcile policy or the reconciledAgentIds once-guard
- No re-fix of the dialog-wedged-until-refresh half of the report (already fixed in e2ea5b5a5c)

autoDecisions.summary: Wipe gate semantics: wipe unless hasLiveTmuxSession === true; absent field still wipes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Preserves the PAN-1520/PAN-1591 fail-safe (never phantom needs-you rows for dead sessions) for every emitter that doesn't know liveness, while fixing the idle-alive flap once emitters assert liveness. Fail direction is a missing entry that W3 restores within 10s, not a phantom entry that persists forever.

autoDecisions.summary: Implement both issue Direction bullets (reducer gate + poller convergence) rather than choosing one.
autoDecisions.rationale: The emitter that flapped the incident agent was not pinned; the reducer gate fixes known emitters, the poller re-emit guarantees convergence for any missed or future emitter. Each slice is independently shippable.

autoDecisions.summary: Poller re-emit via dedup bypass (new pure helper), not a lastEnrichment cache clear.
autoDecisions.rationale: Clearing the cache makes previousEnrichment undefined, so isAwaitingInputRisingEdge would re-fire the awaiting-input activity + TTS every 10s poll (TTS metronome). Bypass keeps rising-edge single-shot (NFR-1).

items.title: Gate the status_changed pending-input wipe on hasLiveTmuxSession

narrative.Action: In packages/contracts/src/event-reducers.ts (agent.status_changed case, wipe block at lines 489-503): compute `const sessionAlive = event.payload.hasLiveTmuxSession === true` and change the wipe condition to `event.payload.status !== 'running' && event.payload.status !== 'starting' && !sessionAlive`. Extend the PAN-1520 comment to cite PAN-2633: an idle-alive agent (stopped-shaped status, live tmux pane) is the archetypal awaiting-operator state and must keep its pending-input payload. No schema change — hasLiveTmuxSession is already Schema.optional(Schema.Boolean) at packages/contracts/src/events.ts:123. Add 4 tests to the existing `describe('applyEvent — agent.status_changed')` block in tests/dashboard/event-reducers.test.ts, seeding an agent snapshot that carries pendingAskUserQuestion/pendingInputKinds/pendingProposedPlan. Rebuild contracts before running the test suite.

narrative.Action: (1) Add a required hasLiveTmuxSession: boolean parameter to buildAgentControlEventPayload (src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/shared.ts:273-291) and include it in the returned payload. (2) In src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/lifecycle-stop.ts, at the pause (line ~233), unpause (~280), and untroubled (~327) status_changed emissions, compute liveness with the async sessionExists(id) from src/lib/tmux.ts (NEVER sessionExistsSync — server code, async-tmux rule) and pass it to the builder. (3) In src/dashboard/server/main.ts (setAgentStoppedNotifier, lines ~393-397) and src/dashboard/server/deacon-main.ts (line ~81), pass hasLiveTmuxSession: false explicitly to buildAgentStatusChangedPayload — these fire when the deacon has determined the session is gone (they emit agent.heartbeat_dead alongside). (4) Verify, without changing, that all deps.notifyAgentStatusChanged calls in src/lib/cloister/deacon-auto-resume.ts (lines 219, 677, 778, 808, 820) already pass an explicit boolean. (5) Audit: run git grep -n "type: 'agent.status_changed'" and confirm each emitter either only emits running/starting status or includes hasLiveTmuxSession; record the emitter census in the commit message.

Enrichment poller re-emits pending payload for idle-alive waiting agents (dedup bypass)

expected_outputs: agent-enrichment-service.test.ts passes including new shouldForceReemitPendingInput cases and the rising-edge regression case

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/services/agent-enrichment-service.ts: add an exported pure helper shouldForceReemitPendingInput(agentStatus: string, enrichment: AgentEnrichment): boolean that returns false when agentStatus is 'running' or 'starting', and otherwise returns true iff enrichment.pendingInputCount > 0 || enrichment.pendingAskUserQuestion != null || enrichment.pendingProposedPlan != null. In pollOnce, change the dedup early-return (currently line 207) to `if (!enrichmentChanged(previousEnrichment, enrichment) && !shouldForceReemitPendingInput(agent.status, enrichment)) { return }`. Add a PAN-2633 comment explaining: a stop-shaped status event can wipe the read model's pending payload and the private lastEnrichment cache cannot see that; while an idle-alive agent still owes the operator an answer, re-emit every poll (~10s) so the read model converges; previousEnrichment stays intact so the PAN-1834 rising edge does not re-fire. Do NOT clear state.lastEnrichment, do NOT touch reconciledAgentIds, do NOT modify the isAwaitingInputRisingEdge block. Tests are pure-helper tests — no timers needed (if any test does exercise the poll interval it MUST use vi.useFakeTimers per repo rule).

items.title: shouldForceReemitPendingInput returns true for agentStatus 'stopped' with an enrichment carrying pendingAskUserQuestion, pendingProposedPlan, or pendingInputCount > 0
shouldForceReemitPendingInput returns false for agentStatus 'running' or 'starting' regardless of pending payload, and false for 'stopped' with an empty enrichment (no pending fields)
pollOnce emits agent.enrichment_changed when enrichmentChanged is false but shouldForceReemitPendingInput is true, so a wiped read model converges within one poll

isAwaitingInputRisingEdge(previous, current) returns false when previous equals current with pendingInputCount > 0 — the forced re-emission never re-triggers the awaiting-input activity entry or TTS (regression test)
Document the liveness-gated wipe + convergence invariant

narrative.Action: Add to the Invariants section of docs/PENDING-INPUT.md: (a) pending-input payloads survive agent status flaps while the agent's tmux session is alive — the agent.status_changed reducer wipes them only when the stop-shaped event does not assert hasLiveTmuxSession: true (PAN-2633; wipe origin PAN-1520); (b) the enrichment poller re-emits for tmux-alive agents whose registry status is non-running while a pending payload exists, so the read model converges within one ~10s poll after any wipe. Search docs/ASKUSERQUESTION-DASHBOARD.md for its description of payload clearing on stop (grep for 'status_changed'/'stopped') and update it to match; if it contains no such description, state that explicitly in the commit message.
